column4: The return of Christ is an important part of our faith. The study of the return of Christ and the end times is known as **eschatology**. Many books on eschatology have been written, and *most of them disagree with each other*! Specifically, they disagree on interpretations (figurative, literal, symbolic), the order and timings of the events in the scriptures. I'm reminded of the saying by the great Pentecostal evangelist Reinhard Bonke - “I will split hairs in heaven when I am done breaking chains on Earth!”

column4: ## **Final Thoughts**
column5: ## **Final Thoughts**

column4: The return of Christ is the culmination of God’s plan and the reason we live and labor with urgency and purpose. The parables of the ten virgins (Matthew 25:1-13) and the two men in the field (Matthew 24:40-42) remind us to be watchful and faithful, always prepared for His return. Whether through the rewards of crowns or the hope of resurrection, our motivation is clear-Christ is coming back!
